notes: 49" FHD (1920x1080) IPS commercial signage display, part of LG's SM5KE series (also sold as 32/43/55SM5KE). Discontinued model. All signal I/O taken from LG's official US spec-sheet PDF (SPEC_SM5KE_061823_PR, rev. 2018/06-2023), which includes a numbered rear-panel connectivity diagram. Caveats: (1) HDMI and DisplayPort input/output version (1.4/2.0 etc.) is not published by LG for this model, so grade is omitted on those ports per instructions rather than guessed. (2) The two RS232C ports are physically 3.5mm TRS "phone" mini-jacks, not full-size DE-9 connectors — LG ships a "Phone to RS232C Gender" adapter cable in the box; mapped to connector "rs232" (closest logical match) with a note. (3) LAN (RJ45) is used for network/control; no Ethernet speed grade is published, so omitted. (4) AC power inlet connector type is not shown on the signal-connectivity diagram in the spec sheet (power specs only state "Built-In Power, 100-240V~ 50/60Hz" with a power cord included accessory) — connector "iec" is an inference based on LG's standard practice for this commercial-display class, not an explicit spec-sheet statement; treat with lower confidence than the signal ports. Not rack-mountable (wall/stand-mount signage panel, VESA 300x300mm, optional stand ST-492T).
